plugins.name: Command Notifier
plugins.description: Runs a local program for each tuliprox notification, with the event as JSON on its standard input. For anything that has no notifier plugin of its own: a script that sends mail, writes a log, drives home automation. Needs the process capability, which the admin approves knowingly: the program runs as the user tuliprox runs as.
plugins.author: tuliprox

plugins.name: Discord Notifier
plugins.description: Delivers tuliprox notifications to a Discord webhook as an embed or plain text. Routing, quiet hours, suppression and retries are the host's; this plugin formats the message and speaks to Discord.
plugins.author: tuliprox

plugins.name: Gotify Notifier
plugins.description: Delivers tuliprox notifications to a Gotify server as push messages, as plain text or as markdown. Routing, quiet hours, suppression and retries are the host's; this plugin formats the message and speaks to Gotify.
plugins.author: tuliprox

plugins.name: ntfy Notifier

plugins.author: tuliprox

plugins.name: Pushover Notifier

plugins.author: tuliprox

plugins.name: REST Notifier
plugins.description: Delivers tuliprox notifications to any HTTP endpoint (a webhook): the event as JSON, or its plain-text body, with your own headers and an optional HMAC signature the receiver can verify. Routing, quiet hours, suppression and retries are the host's; this plugin builds the request and speaks HTTP.
plugins.author: tuliprox

plugins.name: Slack Notifier
plugins.description: Delivers tuliprox notifications to a Slack incoming webhook as Block Kit blocks or plain text. Routing, quiet hours, suppression and retries are the host's; this plugin formats the message and speaks to Slack.
plugins.author: tuliprox

plugins.name: Telegram Notifier
plugins.description: Delivers tuliprox notifications to Telegram chats, groups, topics and channels through a bot, as formatted or plain text. Routing, quiet hours, suppression and retries are the host's; this plugin formats the message, splits a long one, and remembers which chats already have it so a retry never repeats a delivery.
plugins.author: tuliprox

plugins.name: Matrix Notifier
plugins.description: Delivers tuliprox notifications to a Matrix room through the client-server API. Routing, quiet hours, suppression and retries come from the host's messaging outbox; this plugin only speaks Matrix.
plugins.author: tuliprox
